definitions.explanation: Something one hopes for or wants to happen.
A formal or polite request for something.

examples.notes: {願|ねが}いが{叶|かな}う = wish comes true

examples.japanese: {願|ねが}いが{叶|かな}いますように。
{星|ほし}に{願|ねが}いを{込|こ}めた。
examples.english: I made a wish upon a star.
examples.notes: {願|ねが}いを{込|こ}める = to put one's wish into

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{幸|しあわ}せを{願|ねが}うのは、{親|おや}の{一番|いちばん}の{願|ねが}いだ。
examples.english: Hoping for a child's happiness is every parent's greatest wish.

examples.japanese: {平和|へいわ}への{願|ねが}いを{込|こ}めて、{毎年|まいとし}この{祭|まつ}りが{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: This festival is held every year with a wish for peace.

examples.japanese: お{願|ねが}いがあります。
examples.english: I have a request (favor to ask).

examples.notes: One of the most common polite expressions in Japanese

examples.japanese: {退職|たいしょく}{願|ねが}いを{出|だ}した。
{先生|せんせい}に{推薦状|すいせんじょう}のお{願|ねが}いをした。
examples.english: I asked my teacher for a letter of recommendation.

examples.japanese: {休暇|きゅうか}{願|ねが}いを{書|か}いて、{上司|じょうし}に{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: I wrote a leave request and submitted it to my boss.
examples.notes: {休暇|きゅうか}{願|ねが}い = leave request

notes:
USAGE: {願|ねが}い is the noun form of {願|ねが}う (to wish). It's used for hopes, wishes, and formal requests.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{願|ねが}いが{叶|かな}う (a wish comes true)
・{願|ねが}いを{込|こ}める (to put one's wish into)
・お{願|ねが}いします (please - polite request)
・お{願|ねが}いがある (to have a request/favor)

FORMAL REQUEST FORMS:
・{休暇|きゅうか}{願|ねが}い (leave request)
・{退職|たいしょく}{願|ねが}い (resignation request)
・{入学|にゅうがく}{願|ねが}{書|しょ} (application for admission)

NOTE: お{願|ねが}いします is one of the most important polite expressions in Japanese, used for requests and saying 'please'.
